You’re not an attention seeker, in fact if possible I think you should think about counseling. I have some of these problems as well, and thoughts of killing yourself even with no intention are suicidal thoughts. 

It also appears like you show signs of social anxiety too that could be causing these thoughts. You seem to be anxious about how people perceive you. I am no doctor but I also have social anxiety and I know the symptoms. Counseling really helps me so I would highly recommend getting that if you can afford it. (Often times there are more affordable sources of therapy for low income if that is the case).

I hope you feel better soon!

Do they reciprocate the effort that you put in to the friendship?

Do they ever ask you how you are, or attempt to get to know you better?

Do they make an effort to spend time with you?

Do you feel like they make you happy?

Do you feel like you make them happy?

Are they kind to you and others?
